tagline: A four-night boutique riverboat cruise between Luxor and Aswan, with an Egyptologist at every site.
answer: Nile Adventurer is Abercrombie & Kent's 218-foot A&K Sanctuary riverboat on the Nile. She sails four nights between Luxor and Aswan in either direction, with 26 Standard Cabins, two Junior Suites and two Presidential Suites for 60 guests. Children aged 10 and over sail. She suits couples, honeymooners and families who want guided temples by day and a pool deck by afternoon.

overview: Nile Adventurer, an A&K Sanctuary, sails the 130-mile stretch of the Nile between Luxor and Aswan on a four-night cruise, in either direction. The 218-foot boat has a sleek superyacht profile, and its interiors pair earth tones and shades of blue with brass lamps, patterned textiles and dark wood.

There are 30 cabins and suites on four decks: 26 Standard Cabins, two Junior Suites with wraparound windows, and two Presidential Suites with a wraparound balcony and lounge. Every one has Nile views, a king-size bed that converts to twins, and a bath as well as a shower. The boat takes a maximum of 60 guests.

Twice a day you step ashore with an Egyptologist guide at Karnak, Luxor Temple, the Valley of the Kings and the Valley of the Queens, Edfu, Kom Ombo and Philae. Back on board there is a top deck pool with private cabanas, a massage room, Egyptian menus and a cooking class with the chef.
why: She carries 60 guests, you board at A&K's private docking areas in Luxor and Aswan, and every excursion runs with an Egyptologist. The pool, cabanas and massage room give you somewhere to be in the hot middle of the day.

Prices are clear and seasonal. Summer sailings cost roughly half of winter ones, and the two Presidential Suites are the only cabins with their own balcony, so book those first if that matters to you.

days.title: A welcome in Aswan
days.summary: Board at A&K's private dock to a Zaffa musical procession. After lunch, a felucca sail around Elephantine Island, then Lord Kitchener's Botanical Gardens and the Aga Khan Mausoleum.

days.title: Philae and Kom Ombo
days.summary: Morning motorboat to Agilika Island for the relocated Philae temple complex, then the Granite Quarries. Cruise to Kom Ombo for an evening visit to the Temple of Kom Ombo, dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek.

days.title: Edfu, then Luxor
days.summary: Morning visit to the Temple of Edfu, dedicated to Horus and Hathor. Sail to Luxor with an optional cooking class, tour the Temple of Luxor and finish with an Egyptian Night on board.

days.title: Valley of the Kings and Karnak
days.summary: The Valley of the Kings, the Valley of the Queens and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, passing the Colossi of Memnon. Afternoon at the Temple of Karnak, then a farewell gala dinner and dervish show.

days.title: Disembark in Luxor
days.summary: Early breakfast and check out at 8am.

days.title: A welcome in Luxor
days.summary: Board at A&K's private dock to a Zaffa musical procession. After lunch, the East Bank with your Egyptologist: the Temple of Luxor and the Temple of Karnak.

days.title: The West Bank, then Esna
days.summary: The Valley of the Kings, the Valley of the Queens and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, passing the Colossi of Memnon. Lunch on board as the boat cruises to Esna.

days.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo
days.summary: Morning visit to the Temple of Edfu, then sail to Kom Ombo with an optional cooking class. Early evening at the Temple of Kom Ombo and an Egyptian Night on board.

days.title: Philae and a felucca in Aswan
days.summary: Motorboat to Agilika Island for the Philae temple complex and the Granite Quarries. After lunch, a felucca sail around Elephantine Island, then a farewell gala dinner and dervish show.

days.title: Disembark in Aswan
days.summary: Early breakfast and check out at 8am.

pricesNote: Per person, cruise only, USD, two sharing, as published by A&K on 1 Nov 2026. A&K prices by season band, not by sailing date, and the same rate applies in either direction; each departure entry is a band (date to dateTo). Standard Cabin rates rise by deck: Nile, Main, Bridge, Promenade. Festive supplements apply 23 to 31 December, Easter (25 to 28 March 2027) and 2 to 5 August 2027. Single rates run about 1.5 times the sharing rate; third-adult and child rates are published for Nile Deck Standard Cabins and Presidential Suites. Included: all meals, afternoon tea, water, tea and coffee at meals, and guided excursions with transport, entrance fees and port charges. Not included: drinks other than water, tea and coffee at meals; international and domestic flights and transfers; travel insurance, laundry, boutique purchases, spa treatments, gratuities and personal items; optional extras such as a hot-air balloon flight, a Nubian village visit or the Aswan spice market. A&K honeymoon offer: 50% off one partner's stay, travel by 31 Dec 2027 and within 6 months of the marriage certificate, not combinable with other offers, can be withdrawn at any time (https://www.abercrombiekent.com/offers/save-on-your-honeymoon-in-egypt-with-a&k-sanctuary).

faqs: How much does a Nile Adventurer cruise cost?

A&K publishes cruise-only rates per person, two sharing. For 2027 a Standard Cabin starts at US$1,654 in June to August and US$3,235 from October to April; a Presidential Suite runs US$2,687 to US$4,866 outside festive dates. Christmas, Easter and early August dates cost more, up to US$5,966.
What is included on a Nile Adventurer cruise?

All meals, afternoon tea, mineral water, tea and coffee at meals, and guided excursions with transport, entrance fees and port charges. Other drinks, flights and transfers, spa treatments, laundry, gratuities and extras such as a hot-air balloon flight are charged separately.
What is the route and how long is the cruise?

Four nights on the 130-mile stretch of the Nile between Luxor and Aswan, either Luxor to Aswan or Aswan to Luxor. Excursions cover Karnak, the Temple of Luxor, the Valley of the Kings and the Valley of the Queens, Edfu, Kom Ombo and Philae.
What is the difference between Luxor to Aswan and Aswan to Luxor?

The sites are the same. Aswan to Luxor ends with the Valley of the Kings and Karnak on the last full day. Luxor to Aswan starts with Luxor's temples and tombs and ends with Philae and a felucca sail around Elephantine Island. Pick the one that fits your flights.
How many cabins and suites does Nile Adventurer have?

Thirty on four decks for a maximum of 60 guests: 26 Standard Cabins, two Junior Suites with wraparound windows on the Main Deck, and two Presidential Suites with a wraparound balcony and lounge on the Promenade Deck.
Can children sail on Nile Adventurer?
Yes, from age 10. Children aged 15 and under share a cabin with an adult, and the kitchen prepares children's menus.
How do you get to Nile Adventurer?
Fly from Cairo to Luxor (about one hour) or Aswan (about 1 hour 30 minutes), then take a private transfer of about 30 or 45 minutes to A&K's private dock.

Yes. A&K gives newlyweds 50% off one partner's stay on its Nile riverboats, including Nile Adventurer, for travel by 31 December 2027 and within six months of the wedding. It cannot be combined with other offers.
